text:
incident-bot: PAGER: High error rate detected for HelixBank VPC gateway (streaming websocket connections) - paging oncall.

incident-bot: Alerts: 502/504 websocket disconnects spiking, elevated retry backlog. Group: infra/eng-runtime/eng-oncall.

sara_k: seeing it in dashboards - successful connect rate down to ~70% for helixbank-prod over last 10m :frowning:

mike_lin: oncall ack, pulling gateway front logs now. suspected cause: client retries + backend stalled connections causing connection queue explosion.

mike_lin: logs snippet:
```
[stream] client_conn: accept helix-conn id=0x7f3a err=EOF
[stream] api: write failed: write tcp 10.4.2.5:443->10.5.8.12:54022: i/o timeout
[gateway] pool: lease wait > 1500ms, queue=312
```

raj.patel: confirmed dedicated pool for HelixBank (#helix-dedicated) is saturated. autoscaler didn't kick (linked metric mis-config for streaming queue).

emma_support: HelixBank SRE pinged their app team, they report client lib started aggressive retries after last code push earlier today.

mike_lin: quick mitigation options:
- throttle per-tenant new connection rate at gateway (fast to flip)
- reduce client retry window (ask helix)
- pin Helix traffic to smaller model/container variant (lower mem/conn pressure)
- scale dedicated pool now (adds capacity but may be slower to provision)

sara_k: prioritize tenant throttle + route pin + scale. do throttle first to stop new backlog.

raj.patel: applying tenant-level throttle (50r/s) and enabling immediate connection limit for helix-dedicated. running command:
```
redwoodctl gateway apply-config --tenant helixbank --set connection_limit=800 --set new_conn_rate=50
```

deploy-bot: config apply started: task 48392.

mike_lin: enabling fallback streaming-to-polling for connections older than 120s to keep clients alive while we drain queues. config:
```
redwoodctl gateway set-stream-fallback --tenant helixbank --age 120s --mode polling-fallback
```

sara_k: pinged Helix SRE with mitigation plan and asked them to reduce client retry aggressiveness to exponential backoff (initial=250ms, max=5s). they acknowledged.

emma_support: Helix asks if we can do a short windowed IP allow for degraded sessions to maintain UX while they patch. suggesting 30m window.

mike_lin: scaling dedicated pool now: running scaler job to add 4 instances (from 3 -> 7). command:
```
redwoodctl pool scale --name helix-dedicated --replicas 7 --priority emergency
```

deploy-bot: pool scaling job 78421 started; ETA ~4m for GPU nodes to come online.

raj.patel: monitoring KV cache pressure and connection queue. backlog down from 312 -> 90 in 3m after throttle + fallback.

sara_k: rolling handoff in 15m to jen_oncall for night. will summarize actions and risks.

mike_lin: temporary risk: throttling may increase client-side retries and request latency; fallback to polling degrades streaming UX. need to watch for secondary retry storms.

jen_oncall: taking handoff at +15m. please leave exact commands and runbook steps in thread.

sara_k: summary for handoff (copy into pager):
- Impact: HelixBank websocket connect success dropped to ~70%, some requests 502/504. Affected only helixbank-prod tenant on dedicated pool.
- Root cause hypothesis: client-side aggressive retries + autoscaler gap for streaming queue metric -> dedicated pool saturation -> connection queue overflow -> client timeouts.
- Mitigations performed: tenant-level new-connection throttle (50r/s), connection_limit=800, streaming->polling fallback for >120s, scaled helix-dedicated pool to 7 replicas.
- Customer coordination: Helix SRE notified, they will push client lib backoff change (250ms->5s max). Helix accepted 30m degraded window.
- Next actions for oncall: monitor queue < 50, confirm pool replicas healthy, rollback throttle if safe, and track cost impact.

jen_oncall: got it. I'll monitor next 2h and escalate to eng-runtime if queue doesn't drop below 50. also will watch for elevated CPU/GPU usage after scale.

mike_lin: scaling completed, nodes joined. pool healthy = 7, queue now 28.

deploy-bot: task 48392 succeeded. config changes recorded in audit log 2025-08-11T22:34Z.

emma_support: Helix replied: client team will ship a fix within 2h; appreciate the throttling; asked for postmortem.

sara_k: marking incident as mitigated, keeping thread open for postmortem. please add any follow-ups. :white_check_mark:

jen_oncall: follow-ups added to runbook:
- add streaming queue metric to autoscaler trigger
- add tenant backlog alert threshold at 200
- create emergency runbook for pinning routes to polling fallback
- coordinate with infra to pre-warm pool scale for enterprise tenants with high steady-state conn rates

mike_lin: noting also to add client backoff recommendations to enterprise onboarding docs.

incident-bot: Incident HelixBank-STREAM-2025-08-11 status: mitigated -> monitoring.

sara_k: final note: cost for emergency scale will be billed to customer per contract. Helix SRE acknowledged. closing when postmortem complete.

jen_oncall: closing handoff — will watch overnight and file postmortem draft tomorrow.

(reacts: :thumbsup: from mike_lin, :eyes: from raj.patel)
